## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `25cc35082eae4a790c40d29c3c116c8a57edfa57`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/director.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/project-forms.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/seat-post-protocol.md + scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/seat-lifecycle.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/dispatch-runbook.md

Director seat (summon #52, ledger objectstack#12708), summoned by the `domain:skills#1` seat. This PR implements card #26609, which this seat filed from the maintainer's word 「总监不需要巡查 routine，立卡更新 skills」 (2026-10-27T10:12Z); the review is of the diff against that rule, read-only at the head above: the diff, the card, the dev report (6441307561), the head tree (fetched, read with `git show` / `git grep`), the cited files on `origin/main`, the head's check runs. `dispatch-gates --tier`: `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` clause ① ⇒ the rules face, `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`; served at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`. The seat records; it does not approve, ready, queue or merge.

### ① Derived judgments

- **The rule is encoded as the card states it.** Card: the director seat is summon-only in every form, the project-seat form included — no patrol, inbox-scan or daily-digest routine; wakes on the maintainer's summon and its PR subscriptions; digest and inbox scan are duties run within a summon; lane seats' hourly patrol and triage's hourly round untouched. Head text: `project-forms.md:31` 「…分诊席加每小时裸卡轮;总监席不建」, `:32` 「总监席只被维护者召唤与 PR 订阅唤醒;摘要与收件箱扫描在召唤内做;见 lanes/director.md」, `director.md:23` 「本席任何形态都纯召唤制,⛔ 无任何 routine;分诊席默认同项目召唤…」, `SKILL.md:71` 「…巡查 routine(总监席除外)」, `seat-post-protocol.md:66` 「项目席巡查默认每小时(总监席无巡查)…」. Each of the card's five edits is present; lane and triage routines keep their words.
- **Nothing left on the head still hands the director a schedule.** `git grep` for the three retired phrases and the `director.md:16` 例外 clause over `.claude/` on the head tree: no hit. Every remaining 「总监席」 line that mentions 摘要/巡查 names a duty or a destination (`dispatch-runbook.md:39–46`, `seat-lifecycle.md:37, :69`, `seat-post-protocol.md:28`, `triage-duties.md:5`), none a trigger — consistent with the card's "duties run within a summon".
- **`director.md:16` trim (second commit) is right.** 「例外 = `../project-forms.md` 例行」 pointed at the routine project-forms used to grant the director; after `:31–32` it named an empty set, and the card's rule is "no routine in any form". Dropping it makes the file say one thing. The dev raised it as an open question (A keep / B drop); the lane seat chose B and the diff carries it — within the card's rule, not beyond it.
- **Line budget held, pay-downs have surviving homes.** Head line counts equal `main` (319 / 54 / 88 / 91 — all four at ceiling headroom 0 in `check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`); edited lines measure 118 / 112 / 118 / 82 / 113 / 119 bytes against the 120-byte line cap. `SKILL.md:71` lost 「,默认每小时」 — the hourly default still stands at `project-forms.md:31` and `seat-post-protocol.md:66`; `seat-post-protocol.md:66` lost 「,座位贴即现状」 — kept by the same line's 「协议 ⛔ 不复制当前值」 and by 「现值状态恒在座位贴」 in all eight `lanes/*.md` line 3. No rule was deleted to make room.
- **Premise unchanged:** `director.md:7` 「直连 ⛔ 无 Routine/cron」 was already summon-only; the PR extends that to the project form, which is what the maintainer ruled.

### ② Semver level

`.claude/**` publishes nothing; `skip-changeset`; `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none` in the body. No level owed. Correct.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Governed path (`.claude/**`, Tier S): no approval yet; the PR is draft and waits for a `GOVERNED_APPROVERS` review. This seat's account is not one of them; the record is not an approval.
- Check runs on `25cc3508` at this record: 15 `success` (incl. `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Lint · repo & tooling gates` — home of `check:pm-skill-ratchet` and `check:pm-skill-id-lint` — `Lint · PM dispatch-gates`, `Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests`, the PR-body guards, `Test Core`), 18 expected skips, 6 still `in_progress` (`Lint · CI, release & engine gates`, `Lint · docs & code guards`, `Type Check ×4`). Nothing red; a red among the pending re-opens this record.
- Dev deviations read: the two budget trims (judged above); no reviewer requested through MCP (correct under the seat order); commit made before `pnpm install` so no local hook ran — the head's CI is the measurement, and it is the one this record reads.
- Reviewer and card author are the same seat (this one filed #26609 on the maintainer's word). The review is of the implementation against the card's rule, which is the maintainer's; named so the record is read with that in view.

### ④ Design judgment

- `project-forms.md:31–32` (the rule's home): the two lines now split cleanly into "who builds what" and "how the director wakes", with the pointer to `lanes/director.md` where the seat's duties live. Holds against the scenario the card names — a new coordinator seating a director in a project reads these two lines and builds nothing.
- `director.md:23` and `:16`: the charter says summon-only once, in the form clause, and no longer carries an exception that resolves to nothing. `SKILL.md:71` and `seat-post-protocol.md:66`: the project-seat defaults keep their wording for lane seats with a four-character carve-out each, which is the least text that makes the general line true. Holds.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:pm-dispatch 技能里五行同行改写,写明总监席在任何形态下都只靠召唤与 PR 订阅唤醒,不建任何巡查、收件箱扫描或日报 routine;车道席的每小时巡查和分诊席的每小时 Routine 不变。
- 为什么改:你在总监席线程说「总监不需要巡查 routine，立卡更新 skills」;旧文本把项目席的每小时巡查也套到了总监席,导致总监席自建了一个巡查任务(已删)。
- 风险与回滚:只改 `.claude/**` 规则文本,行数不变,不碰代码与发布包;回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`references/project-forms.md` 第 31–32 行与 `references/lanes/director.md` 第 16、23 行。
- 两分钟验证:在 `.claude/` 里搜「总监席加每日摘要」「两者可共用一个 routine」「小时轮可与收件箱扫描」,应零命中。
- 需要你做的:批准本 PR(GOVERNED_APPROVERS),席位随后落地。

席位意见:ACCEPT(待批)。
